name: Punk Rocker 3

features.name: Wild Queue
features.description: Up to three multiplier wilds wait below the reels.

features.name: Enhancer Train
features.description: Brings features from above the reels.

features.name: xWays
features.description: Symbol stacks of two to four.

review:
Same 6x3 layout, now with an Enhancer Train above the reels and a Wild Queue below. At the start of each round, up to three wilds with random multipliers can join the queue.

xWays symbols hold two to four of the same symbol. It's the most structured game in the series – you can see what's coming next. Extreme volatility, 19,089x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
